Employee, 19, shot, killed during pizza shop robbery

BELLAIRE, Texas - A teen employee was shot and killed during a robbery at a pizza shop in Bellaire Sunday.

According to officials, just before 9:30 p.m., police received a 911 call about a robbery at the Reginelli's Pizzeria on Bissonnet.

According to detectives, an armed man entered the restaurant demanding cash. Investigators said the teen, who co-workers identified as 19-year-old Peter Mielke, was the only employee in the dining room area of the restaurant at the time of the robbery. Police said Mielke complied with the robber's demands, but the robber still shot Mielke several times, killing him.
